label: D34-lanjutkan-enrolment-belum-selesai
decision: When a device calls POST /v1/enrollments for a registered card while it already holds an unfinished card instance for that same card (PROVISIONING without a credential, or PENDING_APPROVAL), what should the server do, so that a failed provisioning step or an operator approval does not leave a permanent dead end?

candidates.description: If the same device already holds a PROVISIONING or PENDING_APPROVAL instance for the card, return that instance's {enrollment_id, status} (resume) instead of creating a new one; ENR-DUPLICATE stays for ACTIVE or SUSPENDED instances. The app continues provisioning with the returned ID.

Resume as above, and additionally expire PROVISIONING instances that never received a credential after a fixed time (for example 15 minutes) so they stop counting toward the limit and stop pushing other devices to PENDING_APPROVAL.
Add DELETE /v1/enrollments/{id} for unfinished instances without a credential, called by the app on failure; the server keeps returning ENR-DUPLICATE otherwise.
Keep ENR-DUPLICATE, but expire unfinished PROVISIONING and PENDING_APPROVAL instances after a fixed time so a later retry creates a fresh instance.

priorities: 1) No dead end: a device can always continue to a credential after a failed provisioning step or after operator approval. 2) No permanent residue that blocks the card or a slot (FR-19, FR-15). 3) Never weaken ADR-0032: another device must not skip approval. 4) Minimal new API surface and code.
requirements: After a failed credential call, the same device can obtain a credential for the card with a later request without operator help.
After an operator approves a PENDING_APPROVAL instance, the approved device can obtain a credential.
A different device enrolling the same card still gets PENDING_APPROVAL while the first holder's instance is active.
